definitions.gloss: last time, previous occasion, previous time
definitions.explanation: Refers to the previous instance of a recurring event or action. Commonly used as an adverbial noun (without a particle) to mean 'last time.'

examples.japanese: {前回|ぜんかい}は{失敗|しっぱい}した。
{前回|ぜんかい}の{会議|かいぎ}で{決|き}まったことを{確認|かくにん}しよう。
examples.english: Let's confirm what was decided at the last meeting.

examples.japanese: {前回|ぜんかい}の{試験|しけん}より{成績|せいせき}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: My grades improved compared to the last exam.

notes:
Functions as an adverbial noun — can modify a sentence directly without a particle ({前回|ぜんかい}は or just {前回|ぜんかい} at the start of a clause). Pairs naturally with {次回|じかい} (next time) and {今回|こんかい} (this time).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前回|ぜんかい}の{結果|けっか} — last time's results
- {前回|ぜんかい}の{反省|はんせい}を{活|い}かす — to learn from last time's mistakes
- {前回|ぜんかい}と{比|くら}べて — compared to last time
- {前回|ぜんかい}{同様|どうよう} — same as last time
